title: Guard arcs joined by straight bands on the left and right
summary: On the left and right sides the two guard arcs are joined by a straight band of the arcs' own section (1.4 mm wall, 4 mm tall) along their outer tangent (guard_link_sides); where a band leaves its arc, the slot between them is filled until it is 2 mm wide. There the optimiser's rim narrowed to a strand 0.66 mm wide and 1.13 mm tall, under C7's 1.26 mm wall. The band holds it whole: 6.4 mm^2 of section at the side's middle, where the drawing's thickening alone (decisions/thin-walls-thickened-before-the-drawing-is-opene.json) makes the strand about 1.5 x 2 mm, 2.7 mm^2. The PETG frame weighs 17.03 g, 0.43 g more than without the bands. At the front and back the thickening grows the rim's thin sheets instead. The bands are drawn, not part of the optimiser's problem.

rejected.value: open the side bridges (surface_open_mm 0.35 or more, with nothing thickened first and no bands)
rejected.why: the sides open between the guards, which then end in stubs; the author chose to keep the rim closed and thicken it (2026-10-18)
0.43 g lighter (16.60 g) and over C7's wall, but at the sides' middle the strand comes out about 1.5 x 2 mm (2.7 mm^2) between rims the field drew 4.2 mm tall; with the band the section is 6.4 mm^2
